_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change delegatie-mandaatregister (REQ-DMR-006). A decision can name the delegation or mandate it was taken under ('genomen krachtens'). Optional and nullable, and assistive only: nothing creates, transitions or enacts a decision differently on account of it, whether it is empty, names a withdrawn delegation or one outside its validity window. A property only, so no schema version moves here, as in 132-goals-linked-to-decisions.

authorityBasis.title: Taken under
authorityBasis.description: The delegation or mandate (bevoegdheidsgrondslag) this decision was taken under, shown as 'genomen krachtens' on the decision. Documentation only: it never blocks, warns on or gates the decision. Empty when the decision records no delegated authority.
